title: The activities switching applet doesn't display the wallpaper if 'Wallpaper of  the day' was selected for that specific activity
line: The Activities switcher now shows the Picture of the Day or slideshow image on each activity's tile instead of a stale or default wallpaper.
explanation: The activity switcher finds each activity's wallpaper by reading the desktop's config file, and backgroundFromConfig() only understood the Image and Color wallpaper plugins. For Picture of the Day and Slideshow it returned nothing, so the tile kept whatever it showed before or fell back to the default wallpaper. The change reads the slideshow's Image entry (where it saves its current slide) like the Image plugin, and for Picture of the Day uses the newest cached picture for the configured provider in ~/.cache/plasma_engine_potd.

commits.message:
activitymanager: show Picture of the Day and slideshow wallpapers

Activity tiles only knew how to read image and color wallpapers, so an
activity using Picture of the Day or a slideshow kept a stale or empty
tile. Use the slideshow's saved slide and the cached picture of the day.

BUG: 449823

media.caption: Master: desktop set to Picture of the Day (Bing); the Default tile still shows the old wallpaper
Fixed: same steps, the tile shows the Bing picture
Master: Slideshow wallpaper, after a plasmashell restart the tile shows the default wallpaper
Fixed: the tile shows a slideshow image (the slide saved when plasmashell last quit)
